original_target.title: The first Steklov eigenvalue of a free-boundary minimal hypersurface

scope_comparison: Chodosh–Gianocca Theorem1.1 gives sigma1=1 for embedded genus-zero free-boundary minimal surfaces in the three-ball. It does not cover all surface genera or every higher-dimensional hypersurface. Corollarycatenoid uniqueness also only concerns an annulus and does not settle this all-hypersurface target.

primary_sources.locator: Theorem1.1 and Corollary1.2; reuse independently read source from108.
